summary: Issue #699: Benediction (strategy-wave-120, new province slot kind in TargetSlots), Read the Essence (spell-wave-56, one action with an optional linked second flip for a Void Shugenja), and the Ring entry provenance primitive (MatchState.WlRings, records how each Ring last entered play; enlightenment ignores Rings not entered by their own text) with a new 'after your Ring enters play' reaction trigger, used by Witness the Untold (spell-wave-57), Fudo's Assurances (celestial-wave-29), Introspection and Yung.
